label: visual-only
vendored_note: Nothing was downloaded or vendored. The bake imports the repo's own sun-position and Bird & Hulstrom models and uses published formulas and constants; no third-party code or asset ships.

sources.name: Meeus, Astronomical Algorithms, 2nd ed. (1998), ch. 25, as implemented in core/scenario/solar.py solar_position
sources.used_for: sun elevation and azimuth from place, date and clock time

sources.name: Bird & Hulstrom 1981, A Simplified Clear Sky Model for Direct and Diffuse Insolation on Horizontal Surfaces (SERI/TR-642-761), as implemented in core/scenario/solar.py
sources.licence: US government technical report (public domain); repo code
sources.used_for: direct normal illuminance under the stated marine aerosol and water column

sources.name: IES RP-21 clear-sky horizontal diffuse illuminance, constants as stated in core/scene/beauty_look.py IES_CLEAR_DIFFUSE_KLX
sources.used_for: sky diffuse illuminance; the added haze forward-scatter share is this lane's MODEL step, UNCALIBRATED

sources.name: Koschmieder 1924 visibility relation, V = 3.912 / extinction
sources.used_for: tying the aerosol optical depth to the sea-haze visibility other lanes use

sources.name: Hansen & Travis 1974, Light scattering in planetary atmospheres, Space Sci. Rev. 16 (Rayleigh optical depth fit)
sources.used_for: spectral Rayleigh extinction for the sun colour

sources.name: Wyman, Sloan & Shirley 2013, Simple Analytic Approximations to the CIE XYZ Color Matching Functions, JCGT 2(2)
sources.used_for: CIE 1931 xy of the attenuated sun spectrum

sources.name: McCamy 1992, Correlated color temperature as an explicit function of chromaticity coordinates, Color Res. Appl. 17
Cox & Munk 1954, Measurement of the roughness of the sea surface from photographs of the sun's glitter, JOSA 44
sources.used_for: sea-glitter peak luminance (recorded, not exposed for)

sources.name: ISO 2720:1974 incident-light exposure meter calibration, C = 250
Lagarde & de Rousiers 2014, Moving Frostbite to Physically Based Rendering (SIGGRAPH course notes), Lmax = 1.2 * 2^EV100
sources.used_for: scene-linear value of a luminance at a manual EV100

research_candidates_not_adopted.name: sosfuse2
research_candidates_not_adopted.reason: twilight only (sun +6 to -18 deg). It is the right source for extending this table below 2 deg, but it is unvetted and bundles CC BY-SA inputs; not fetched. Named as the follow-up.

research_candidates_not_adopted.name: Poly Haven Qwantani time-of-day pure-sky series
research_candidates_not_adopted.reason: CC0 and the best check of this lane's sun:sky ratio and colour against time of day, but 13 multi-hundred-MB HDRIs that would change no shipped number until someone fits them; not fetched. Named as the calibration follow-up.

research_candidates_not_adopted.name: Poly Haven kloofendal pure-sky HDRI
research_candidates_not_adopted.reason: same as above: a cross-check, not a dependency.

research_candidates_not_adopted.name: MoonShineR
research_candidates_not_adopted.reason: GPL-3 offline tool with a night and twilight focus; the repo already has a daylight model. Not fetched.

research_candidates_not_adopted.name: skylight (bluegreen-labs)
research_candidates_not_adopted.reason: AGPL-3.0; not needed for daylight. Not fetched.

research_candidates_not_adopted.name: Filament scotopicAdaptation
research_candidates_not_adopted.reason: low-light colour shift; belongs to a colour-grading lane and to light levels this table does not reach.

research_candidates_not_adopted.name: Prague Sky Model dataset
research_candidates_not_adopted.reason: multi-GB, and its licence is only 'as stated on record', unverified. Not fetched.

research_candidates_not_adopted.name: PerezSky
research_candidates_not_adopted.reason: MIT and relevant to a hazy or overcast sky luminance distribution, but tier 0 needs only the horizontal illuminance, which the IES term plus the haze share gives. Not fetched.
